verdict.rationale: Simular is a computer-use agent, so how it locates UI elements is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence only says it controls computers "like a human — UI, keyboard, and mouse" and lets you watch sessions. Nothing documents whether it grounds UI elements via accessibility tree, OCR, set-of-marks, or coordinates, so there is no basis for debugging misclicks. Live-watching transparency and self-healing skills are adjacent features and earn no credit here.
